BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning traumatic brain injury screenings for children entering the foster care system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to traumatic brain injury screenings for children entering the foster care system; adding a new section to chapter 70.250 RCW; and providing an expiration date.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 70.250 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) In order to improve health outcomes for children placed in out-of-home placement pursuant to chapter 13.34 RCW, the collaborative shall evaluate the most effective and beneficial way to screen children placed in out-of-home care for traumatic brain injuries.
(2) By December 1, 2020, and in compliance with RCW 43.01.036, the collaborative shall report, at a minimum, the following information to the governor and the legislature:
(a) The most effective way to screen children entering foster care for traumatic brain injury; and
(b) Recommendations as to when the screenings should occur, who should conduct the screenings, and what screening tools should be used to conduct the screenings.
